title: 高市首相 オーストラリア着 エネルギー円滑流通で共同声明へ

translated_text: Prime Minister Takachi, who completed their schedule in Vietnam, arrived in Australia on the 3rd (Japan time) as their next destination. On the 4th, they will hold talks with Prime Minister Albanese and issue a joint statement aimed at ensuring the smooth distribution of energy resources including LNG (liquefied natural gas).
title_en: PM Takachi Arrives in Australia, Joint Statement on Smooth Energy Distribution Expected
